description: A function property holding an empty object is an error
notes: The JSON spec flattens each label level into a sequence of properties, each naming a label value, so an empty object gives no function names and declares no functions. hashicorp/hcl requires at least one property at each label level and reports an error ((*body).unpackBlock in json/structure.go; see json/bodies/block-label-level-empty-object-is-error).
